DEGLS.alias: GLS Mobility GmbH / bill.bo payment platform

evidence.finding: GLS Mobility GmbH identifies itself as provider of bill.bo, a cloud payment/billing platform for charging-station operators.

GLS Mobility's operator documentation states that operators configure the conditions for their site operators, proving pricing can be operator/site-specific rather than a universal DEGLS network tariff.
GLS Mobility describes its direct-payment software/payment infrastructure as attached to more than 10,000 charge points, including third-party infrastructure.
A current public station record labelled GLS Mobility shows 0.54 EUR/kWh ad-hoc; kept only as station-level discovery evidence.
Another current public station record labelled GLS Mobility shows 0.42 EUR/kWh, demonstrating observed tariff heterogeneity; not promoted as authoritative tariff data.

DEGLS.decision: Do not apply any global DEGLS tariff. Resolve exact direct price by EVSE/site/operator using bill.bo/QR/direct-payment endpoint or another station-level authoritative source. Prefix can be classified partial because operator identity and tariff-authority heterogeneity are now established.
DEGLS.unblockForComplete: Enumerate canonical DEGLS EVSEs and obtain the exact current direct-payment contract for each tariff cohort or every EVSE from bill.bo/QR/public operator endpoints.
